title: Yellowed Crisp Tunisian Fish Skewers
description: A pescatarian-friendly Tunisian dish featuring emmentaler cheese and a nutty, crisp texture, air-fried to perfection. This adventurous recipe is perfect for those looking to try something new.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cod pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated cod pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the shredded emmentaler cheese over the cod pieces.
Air-fry the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the cheese is golden brown.
Sprinkle the toasted pine nuts and chopped parsley over the skewers.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
